brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, ideally 1600x900 or larger. This is for the Japanese site バスケまとめ.

Content grounded in the supplied fixed manuscript: 2026-11-06 has scheduled games, all were pregame as of 02:18 JST. Daily individual performance records are awaiting official finalization. Do not imply anyone played, scored, won, or was selected to a best five. No scores or player statistics.

Visual style: match the approved black-and-lime basketball ink illustration style viewed in this conversation. Deep nearly black background #151A18, vivid lime #CCF43B brush marks, warm ivory bold Japanese headlines. Energetic hand-drawn ink, expressive hatching, rough dry-brush textures, highly legible typography and few elements. Visibly hand-illustrated editorial art, no photographic rendering.

Person: exactly one real professional basketball player, Ryan Kriener (ライアン・クリーナー) of Shiga Lakes, randomly selected from the teams named in the manuscript. His official current portrait has been inspected for likeness. Preserve these actual features: tall broad powerful athletic build, fair/light skin, short straight dark-brown hair swept to his right with a neat side part, short sides, broad forehead, straight eyebrows, light gray-blue eyes, straight fairly narrow nose, medium-width mouth, angular oval jaw, clean-shaven face with only faint natural jaw shadow. Use the inspected official profile portrait as likeness guidance, but draw original ink illustration, never paste a photograph. His recognizable face should be clear and light enough to inspect, with a focused expression. Plain dark sleeveless basketball jersey with light trim. Completely blank uniform with no names, numbers, branding, logos or sponsors.

Composition: player occupies the LEFT 45% of the picture, shown in a dynamic three-quarter body pivot stance, torso twisting toward the right, one knee bent, holding an orange basketball firmly in BOTH hands near waist/chest level as he prepares a quick pass. It is a generic imagined playing pose. Clear anatomically correct two arms, two hands, plausible fingers gripping the sides of the ball. Keep head, elbows, hands and entire ball inside the frame. Strong diagonal lime brush stroke behind him, restrained court-like curved line low in the background. No additional people, no arena-specific scene, no hoop needed. All important text on the RIGHT 50%, uncluttered. Player lower body may end at mid-thigh at the lower composition boundary. Never obscure his face or hands with text. This is an illustration/image concept, not a recreation of an actual game or a depicted performance claim.

Exact text to render, no other text:
Small upper-right masthead: "バスケまとめ"
Large lime date: "11/06"
Largest very bold ivory Japanese headline: "試合予定"
Smaller readable white two-line subtitle:
"当日の成績は"
"公式記録の確定待ち"
Small but clearly readable timestamp beneath subtitle: "11/06 02:18 JST時点"
Bottom footer, clearly readable in ivory with generous margins:
"イラスト（AI生成）" and "イメージ"

Hierarchy: date and 試合予定 dominate, pending qualifier remains clearly visible, footer label is intact and legible. Minimum 5% safe margins for text. High contrast, professional sports editorial composition. All letters and numbers must be accurate Japanese. No player name in the graphic. No claim about Ryan's participation or performance. No team logo, league logo, sponsor text, watermarks, official photographs, scoreboards, statistics, medals, trophy or invented slogans. Return only one finished artwork.

ONE ALLOWED REVISION
Edit the FIRST image, the finished black-and-lime Japanese basketball thumbnail. The SECOND image is the official profile photograph of the real player Ryan Kriener, and serves ONLY as a facial identity reference.

Make exactly one targeted correction: improve the illustrated player's likeness to Ryan Kriener from the second image. Preserve the existing hand-ink/brush illustration style. Draw his actual short DARK brown nearly black hair, neat compact shape with short sides and a flatter side-parted top swept to his right. Reduce the tall voluminous quiff and golden highlights. Match the reference's fuller oval facial proportions, broader cheeks, slightly softer angular chin, straight narrower nose, straighter eyebrows, medium-width lips, visible ears, and young clean-shaven face. Keep faint jaw shadow only. His face must visibly resemble the real reference person while maintaining the current focused playing expression and three-quarter head direction. Render the head as original ink artwork. Do not paste the photo or make the face photorealistic.

Keep the exact current canvas ratio and resolution, composition, orange ball, athletic body, passing pose, two hands and fingers, plain blank uniform, lime brush strokes and every Japanese text string. All text must read exactly:
バスケまとめ
11/06
試合予定
当日の成績は
公式記録の確定待ち
11/06 02:18 JST時点
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

No name, number, logo, sponsor or performance statistic. No second person. Return exactly one corrected finished thumbnail.
